title: PNP stands firm on arrest of Sept. 21 protesters
summary: The Philippine National Police is standing by its decision to file criminal charges against eight individuals accused of assaulting police officers during the September 21 protests last year, despite…

blocks.text: The Philippine National Police is standing by its decision to file criminal charges against eight individuals accused of assaulting police officers during the September 21 protests last year, despite a Manila court's reported decision to quash the cases for insufficient evidence.
